faqs.a:
Pursuant to section
5.11
of the Home Rule Charter of the city, there is hereby adopted as a primary code by
               reference the "Engineering Code of Standards and Specifications" as promulgated by
               the city engineer and published by the engineering division of the department of public
               works, City of Arvada, Colorado, and dated October 23, 2023. That previous code titled
               "Engineering Code of Standards and Specifications" dated July 26, 2022, is hereby
               repealed. Construction plans that the city engineer has approved in writing prior
               to the effective date hereof shall be considered valid, provided construction of the
               improvements related thereto is completed within two years of the effective date of
               a public improvement agreement, development agreement, building permit, or similar
               document requiring such construction or, in the absence of such, within two years
               of the approval of the construction plans.
(Code 1981, § 27-190; Ord. No. 2391, § 1, 1-19-1987; Ord. No. 2429, § 1, 7-20-1987;
